divergence_log: Classical first-order BCH captures only the leading [A,B] correction for generic real matrices. Lost relative to the nonclassical shell: higher-order nested commutators of the full Dynkin series, unitary-group curvature terms relevant to holonomy and Berry-phase structure, Lie-algebraic structure constants under constraint-admissible generators, and the noncommutative geometry that governs coupled-generator evolution beyond the perturbative window.
